renamed in the IDB: the research screen's four 32-byte UiControl descriptors at 0xABB10, walked by ResearchScreen_Init's UiControl_Setup loop

renamed in the IDB: the byte ResearchScreen_RebuildTopicList writes with the topic number that just finished (0x74414 STRB R7,[R1]); Geoscape_Draw reads it at 0x8D498 as a topic index and follows its +0x1D group

renamed in the IDB: the dword ResearchScreen_RebuildTopicList writes with the finished topic (0x74424) and with the topic the unlock roll picked (0x74644); Ufopaedia_Open switches on it minus 118 (0x9DF10) and Geoscape_Draw indexes dword_AA5F0 with it (0x8D3F8)

renamed in the IDB: the byte ResearchScreen_BuildPanels sets at 0x73410 and clears at 0x7394C, which Geoscape_CloseUI (0x8BDC8) also clears; ResearchScreen_Draw returns before any panel, label or control while it is zero (0x73BE8)

renamed in the IDB: the byte PlaySample7_SetFlags_Cache0xBD8 (0x73328, the research panel A click) sets and ResearchScreen_StartSelected (0x73244) clears; ResearchScreen_Draw branches on it at 0x73D64 between blitting the close control and drawing the detail panel

renamed in the IDB: the byte BuySellScreen_Draw writes only on its panels-not-built half -- 1 inside the cursor gate at 0x78B14, 0 outside it at 0x78B94; all five cross-references sit in that tail, so the built half leaves it alone

renamed in the IDB: the shared panel byte BuySellScreen_Draw copies into pBuySellPanelB/C bUnk7080 and then zeroes (0x7888C..0x788A4, 0x78180..0x7819C); BasePlaneScreen_DrawCraftDetail (0x7BE40) and TransferScreen_Draw (0x98228) use the same byte

renamed in the IDB: 0x186BC0 is a POINTER to the current zoom's world map-bits glyph record {u16 w, u16 h, u8 indexed[w*h]}, not the u16 pair itself. Geoscape_InitUI (0x85A18) allocates 0x4E204 = 800*400+4 and stores it; Smap_ZoomIn (0x81E9C..0x81EB8) and Smap_ZoomOut only rewrite the pair through it, and RadarScreen_BlitMapBackdrop passes it as SoftSurf_BlitFlip's pSrc (0x5EC18)

renamed in the IDB: the u8 RadarScreen_BlitMapBackdrop toggles -- set-and-skip at 0x5EB28, draw-and-clear at 0x5EB38; RadarScreen_Init clears it (0x5F4CC) and RadarScreen_Update reads it for the 50-against-0 pick (0x60584) and the flashing message colour block (0x61144)

renamed in the IDB: the x origin subtracted from the tile x in Smap_GetTileAtMode (0x821D0) and from the scroll in the geoscape map blits (0x5EBD0, 0x6C238, 0x8C3D4). Geoscape_Draw (0x8C3D4) is its only writer

renamed in the IDB: aPalette (0x1472D0) + 29 * 1024, the palette base RadarScreen_BlitMapBackdrop builds as aPalette + 0x7400 (0x5EC28) and hands to SoftSurf_BlitFlip as its fourth argument; it carries no direct xrefs because it is only ever reached through the aPalette base

renamed in the IDB: eleven PadImage pointers RadarScreen_Init allocates (0x5FE44..0x5FE94) and loads as i0..i9 through palette slot 0x19 (0x5FE98..); RadarScreen_DrawFuelGauge indexes them with the hundreds, tens and units digits of the consumed-fuel percentage
renamed in the IDB: the eleventh slot of aRadarDigitPads, loaded separately at 0x5FF40 and always blitted by RadarScreen_DrawFuelGauge at x 192 (0x5DADC)

renamed in the IDB, typed u8: the only thing RadarScreen_DrawFuelGauge keeps of the percentage -- set when the consumed figure reaches 100 (0x5D9F4), cleared by RadarScreen_Init (0x5F4BC), read nine times by RadarScreen_Update
renamed in the IDB: the per-craft-class radar range limit RadarScreen_Init stores in its bCraftClass switch (240 in the first arm, 0x5F6F4) and RadarScreen_DrawRangeBar gates against (0x5D744)

renamed in the IDB: the per-craft-class level RadarScreen_Init stores -- 8, 6, 4, 2 and 0 at 0x5F6D8, 0x5F7A8, 0x5F878, 0x5F944 and 0x5F9E8, while three of the eight class arms leave it at whatever the previous intercept left. RadarScreen_DrawRangeBar shifts its gate by 560*(level-13)/114, and RadarScreen_DrawOverlay and RadarScreen_DrawCraftArmament read it too
renamed in the IDB, typed u8 (LDRB at 0x5F494): the open/closed flag RadarScreen_Init toggles on -- flag 0 runs the open path, flag 1 the teardown
named in the IDB, typed int: the Map.apCraft index (Map+0x10AC) of the current intercept; RadarScreen_Init reads its weapon mounts and RadarScreen_RollDetection its uFuelCap
named in the IDB, typed int: the strategList index of the tracked contact, read through PtrArray_Get by RadarScreen_Init, RadarScreen_RollDetection and RadarScreen_RollWeaponHit
named in the IDB as UiControl*[5]: the radar screen's five control singletons, click handlers installed at +0xC in the order NW, NE, SW, SE, BlitMapBackdrop (0x5FCB8..0x5FCF4)
named in the IDB as PadImage*[5]: i_but3, i_but4, i_but2, i_but5, i_but6 in mode 26 at (117,86), (161,86), (117,107), (161,107), (117,128)

named in the IDB as UiControlDesc[5] (the IDB's own 32-byte descriptor layout): the five descriptors RadarScreen_Init hands to UiControl_Setup; entries 0..3 name pads i_but0/i_but1, entry 4 names i_but7/i_but8

renamed in the IDB, typed u8: set by RadarScreen_RollDetection when the tracked contact outruns the intercept craft (0x604E0); it is the gate the four radar corner buttons open on, so a lost trace also freezes the cursor. Only the open path of RadarScreen_Init clears it

renamed in the IDB, typed u8: set by RadarScreen_SetCursorSE and by RadarScreen_RollDetection (0x604D4); RadarScreen_DrawOverlay reads it sixteen times and RadarScreen_CyclePalette uses it for its extra four range steps

renamed in the IDB, typed int: the right mount's ammo, same sentinels. A twin mount splits one pool as ammo/2 and ammo/2+(ammo%2) (0x5FBE4..0x5FC04)
